div.div: جَذْلَانُ [in copies of the K with tenween, but correctly without tenween, for the fem. is جَذْلَآءُ,] Joyful, glad, or happy; (S, K;) as also ↓ جَذِلٌ ; (K;) and ↓ جَاذِلٌ occurs in poetry: (IDrd, K:) pl. جُذْلَانٌ. (K.) You say, نَفْسُهُ جَذْلَآءُ بِذٰلِكَ His soul is joyful, glad, or happy, by means of that. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
